title: docs(adr): ADR-0025 v2 says what M1 shipped — the local install loop, the trusted-key store, the native-addon refusal, manifest-deps retired (#27684)

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEsWMgMazMEzGNW4yuNJbZb)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改 `docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` 一个文件，把 ADR-0025 v2 里被 M1 三片（#27335、#27374、#27679）变成假话的说法改成代码现在的样子。卡上点名的 8 处：§3.5 的 M1 条改成 ✅ 已落地行；§7 按裁决 6467932167（B′）加一条带日期的说明（M1 已有最小形态的可信公钥库）；"Steps 4–7 不存在、没有 `os plugin install`" 那句；§3.2 示例注释；§3.3 两句（原生插件拒绝、`manifest-deps` 构建半边已删）；§3.5 第 5 步的 pnpm install；§5 风险一条。另有同类 3 处（席位已同意就地修）：状态行、§3.4 第 2 步"验签没有生产调用方"、§3.6"没有任何东西按 tier 分派"。Q6 等正确的历史记录行一字未动。
- **为什么改：** ADR 是后续卡片和 AI 都要读的约束文本。现在它还说"没有 `os plugin install`"、"构建还不拒绝原生插件"、"可选用 manifest-deps 缓解"，会把人和 AI 引向已经不存在或已退役的东西。这是 #27123 欠下的 Tier H 文档收尾。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文档，无代码、无行为变化。风险只在措辞是否与代码一致：每一句替换文字都在 `origin/main` f5dd0575 上实测过，证据见下方 What changes。M1 的验收（cloud 车道 Stripe 样例端到端，#27570）还没做，✅ 行如实写了"仍未完成"。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** §3.5 的 ✅ M1 行和它上面改写的 "Steps 4–7" 句；§7 的日期说明；第 3 行状态行。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `grep -n "M1 adds\|nothing dispatches\|Steps 4–7 do not\|no production caller\|mitigated by the opt-in" docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md`，预期零命中（同一条命令在 main 上命中 5 行，都是被更正的假话）；再运行 `grep -n "manifest-deps" docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md`，预期剩下的每一行都在说它已退役。
- **需要你做的：** 现在无需操作。契约审查（fable）尚欠，由席位进行，尚未请求批准；审查通过后席位再请你批准，批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` (+45 / −33). Every replacement sentence was measured on `origin/main` `f5dd0575`; line numbers below are on that commit unless marked.

The eight edits the card lists:

| # | Where | Was | Now | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | §3.5, the M1 bullet | the plan | ✅ landed 2026-10-29 (#27335, #27374, #27679), what each step does, and the acceptance run on the cloud Stripe sample still open (#27570) | `install.ts` header steps 1–6; `installed-plugin-loader.ts` header checks 0–5; `plugin-installation-store.ts` header (local stand-in for the `sys_package_installation` row); `disable.ts`, `uninstall.ts` headers; #27570 open, `status:parked`, `domain:cloud` |
| 2 | §7, key management | deferred to M3 | + a dated note, as ruling `6467932167` ordered: the trusted-key store landed in M1 in its minimal form; rotation and the `platform` / `cloud` sources stay M3 | `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-trusted-key.object.ts` (`source` select `local` / `platform` / `cloud`, `status` `active` / `revoked`); `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/keygen.ts`; `trust/{add,list,revoke}.ts`; install refuses an unknown or revoked key id (`install.ts` header step 1), the loader too (`signature_key_untrusted`, `signature_key_revoked`) |
| 3 | §3.5, "Steps 4–7 do not exist … there is no `os plugin install`" | false | steps 4–7 exist for a local artifact only (step 7's per-plugin enforcer is M2); in the cloud nothing serves the `.osplugin` back | `install.ts` exists and takes a file path only (`Args.string`, "Path to the .osplugin artifact"); §3.4's download-route sentence is unchanged and still true |
| 4 | §3.2, `// bundled \| manifest-deps` | stale | `// bundled, the one strategy` | `manifest.zod.ts:258` `enumWithRetiredValues(['bundled'], PACKAGING_RETIRED)` |
| 5 | §3.3, "the build does not yet refuse them mechanically (M1 adds the refusal)" | false | `os plugin build` refuses a native addon before writing anything | `build.ts:303` `findNativeAddons` and the refusal, before `computeIntegrity`; the only writes are `build.ts:331–332`, after it; esbuild runs with `write: false` (`build.ts:271`) |
| 6 | §3.3, "the build-side half is removed in M1" | future tense | done: the schema refuses `manifest-deps` by name with its prescription; M1 (#27679) removed the build half | `manifest.zod.ts:238–258` (`PACKAGING_RETIRED`); `build.ts` header step 2 (everything but `@objectstack/*` inlined) |
| 7 | §3.5 step 5, "For manifest-deps, run `pnpm install …` here" | stale | *v2:* nothing is installed there; install runs no package manager | `install.ts` header: verify, read, re-verify integrity, materialize, record; no package-manager call in `install.ts` |
| 8 | §5 Negative, "mitigated by the opt-in manifest-deps strategy in Phase 5" | false | the build refuses native addons; with manifest-deps retired a plugin that needs one waits for M3 (§3.3) | §3.3's own retirement paragraph; `build.ts:303` |

Three more in the same file, same defect class (made false by slices 1–3), fixed in place under os-dev's bounded in-place rule and agreed by the seat before the edit (claim 6511498060's file-surface line names them):

| # | Where | Was | Now | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | §3.6 v2 paragraph | "**nothing dispatches on the tier at load**"; "Until M3, the publish-time refusal is the only tier gate" | the boot-time loader dispatches (`node` imported in process; `sandbox` / `worker` and an undeclared tier refused by name); until M3 nothing loads isolated | `installed-plugin-loader.ts:180–195` `dispatchPluginRuntime` (`runtime_undeclared`, `runtime_not_dispatched`); `manifest.zod.ts:214–222` describe; listed as owed in the slice-2 hand-over 6496079064 |
| 10 | §3.4 step 2 | "`verifyPluginArtifact` … has **no production caller until M1** (the loader checks only that a signature is well-formed)" | install and every boot verify against the environment's trusted keys; `plugin-loader.ts` refuses a signature no host verified | `install.ts:254` `verifyPublisherSignature`; `installed-plugin-loader.ts:341` `verifyPluginArtifact`; `plugin-loader.ts:519–552` |
| 11 | Status line | M1 listed under "Not yet built" | M1 listed under what landed (acceptance run still open); the cloud fetch stays M2, tier dispatch beyond `node` stays M3; "amended 2026-10-30 to what M1 shipped" | the three merged PRs above; `docs/adr/README.md` index cell unchanged (`adr-index --check` OK) |

Kept as written, because they correctly record the retirement: the v2 note (L15), the artifact tree (L141–142), the §3.3 RETIRED bullet head, the Q6 row, the §4 M1 phasing bullet and the Phase 5 mapping line.

## Tests

None: an ADR text change, no code and no tested behaviour, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- **Line budget:** net +12 against the order's "≈ 0". Where it went: the §7 note the ruling ordered (+5, new content), §3.6 (+3, item 9), §3.3 (+2), the §3.5 M1 line (+2); the status line and every other hunk 0. Nothing was re-wrapped to buy lines.
- **Deviation, declared:** items 9–11 are outside the card's eight. The order's mechanism assumption ("only fix the eight") was measured false: those three sentences would contradict the new ✅ line. Reported to the seat before the edit; the seat amended the claim.
- **The ✅ line is not a full acceptance:** #27123's acceptance e2e on the cloud `plugins/connector-stripe` sample is #27570 (cloud lane, parked). The line says so.
- **§7 note wording:** the ruling's order reads "rotation policy and platform / cloud sources stay M3"; the note uses that phrasing. The ruling's own body places the `cloud` rows with M2's chain; the note does not restate that schedule.
- Observation, not edited (original design text, not one of the eleven and not contradicted by M1): §3.7 "Supply chain. Lockfile + per-file integrity …" still names a lockfile, which a bundled-only artifact does not carry.
- Observation, not filed (code comment drift, outside this card's surface): `sys-trusted-key.object.ts`'s docblock says install verifies with `verifyPluginArtifact` (it calls `verifyPublisherSignature`, which `verifyPluginArtifact` wraps) and names the boot-time loader as not yet built.
- No changeset: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` is set with this PR's creation.
